verdicts:
Per-claim verdicts (checker holds claims 1, 3, 5, 7, 9; claims 2, 4, 6, 8 not held — reserved for the objective/subjective lanes).

Claim 1 — CONFIRMED. Report § Rows table (conform-process-report.md:9-24) carries a disposition for all 14 rows the brief and its Fleet rows section name: process-subj-1..6 `applied`, process-obj-1 `stopped` with a deviation (§ Deviations, report.md:104-125), process-obj-2..6 `applied`, fleet-F1 and fleet-F2 `noop` each with cited evidence (report.md:23-24). This set matches exactly the 12 numbered rows in conform-process-brief.md § Rows (process-subj-1 through process-obj-6) plus the 2 named under § Fleet rows (fleet-F1, fleet-F2). No row is absent from the table.

Claim 3 — CONFIRMED, vacuously. No row in this round renames or removes a published symbol: process-obj-1, the only row whose repair required removing tracked files (src/server/{Process,ProcessManager,Session,Supervisor}.ts moving into a folder), is `stopped` and its own report reads "the tree carries no partial move" (report.md:117-118), confirmed by `git status --short` (conform-process.status) showing no new/deleted files under `src/server/processes/`. process-subj-6 explicitly keeps `SupervisorFace` and adds no `launch` row ("Keep the identifier"; brief row process-subj-6 Repair). process-obj-2 adds `Supervisor` to the barrel without renaming it. With no old name to sweep, the claim's condition (no old name survives) holds on the diff's own evidence rather than on a sweep the report ran against `guides/README.md` specifically — the report's sweeps table (report.md:67-74) does not name `guides/README.md` as a swept path, which would matter only if a rename or removal had landed.

Claim 5 — CONFIRMED. `ProcessChildInterface`'s three call-signature members in the diff (src/server/types.ts: `kill`, `once`, `off`, conform-process.diff:277-315) exactly match the new guide method table (guides/process.md diff:113-124: `kill`, `once`, `off`, no more, no fewer). `Supervisor`'s four public methods in src/server/Supervisor.ts (verified directly: `deliver`, `end`, `stop`, `destroy` at Supervisor.ts:260,298,315,329, and no other public method) exactly match its new guide method table (diff:125-137). `Supervisor` gained an Entities row (diff:58) and a Vocabulary row (diff:178) consistent with its barrel addition; because `Supervisor` implements no published interface, the guide/source `surface()` parity the installed parser enforces (node_modules/@orkestrel/guide/dist/src/core/index.js:1646,1723, entity-level, not member-level) does not require a Surface-row listing of its getters, so their absence from Surface is not a parity gap. The new `@example` in Supervisor.ts imports `@orkestrel/process/server` (diff:231), the published specifier. No `AGENTS §` citation appears in the diff, guides/process.md, or README.md (grep, no matches). `guides/README.md` is untouched, correctly: it is a module-level (not per-export) directory/concept index (guides/README.md:9,15-16 list only `process.md` for `src/core` and `src/server`), and adding one export inside an already-listed module needs no new row there.

Claim 7 — CONFIRMED. `git status --short` (conform-process.status) lists exactly 13 paths, all inside the brief's Owned scope (`src/**`, `tests/**` excluding the vendored trio, `guides/process.md`, `README.md`): README.md, guides/process.md, src/core/types.ts, src/server/{Supervisor,index,types}.ts, tests/guides.test.ts, tests/setupServer.ts, tests/src/server/{Process,Session,Supervisor,helpers}.test.ts, tests/src/server/factories.test.ts. No `package-lock.json`, no `node_modules/**`, and no off-limits file (`.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `scripts/**`, `.oxlintrc.json`, etc.) appears. No compatibility alias, re-export, or shim was added: the diff's only new export row is `export * from './Supervisor.js'` (diff:271), the class itself, not a renamed re-export of anything.

Claim 9 — CONFIRMED. A grep of the diff for `TODO|FIXME|XXX` and for `console.(log|debug|warn|error)` returns no matches. No commented-out code block appears; the diff's comment additions (Process.test.ts:414-415, helpers.test.ts:950-951, tests/src/server/helpers.test.ts:929-935) are prose explaining a timeout or a stale-comment correction, not disabled code. The report's § Files touched table (report.md:26-42) names the same 13 files the diff and status show, with no extra or missing entry.
findings: No finding outside the numbered claims. One item was investigated and closed rather than raised: whether `Supervisor`'s public getters (`stdout`, `pid`, `code`, `signal`, `evidence`, `settled`, `stopping`, `ending`, `exit`) needed a guide Surface-row listing now that the class is barrelled. Direct inspection of the installed `@orkestrel/guide` parser shows `surface()` operates at the entity-name level, not the member level, so this is not a parity gap and is not carried forward.
